goal: Backup and restoration rehearsal automation with verifiable RPO/RTO metrics.
summary: Implemented automated PostgreSQL database backup, encryption, and restoration rehearsal automation with verifiable RPO/RTO metrics. Created scripts/backup/backup-database.sh, scripts/backup/restore-rehearsal.sh, and scripts/backup/backup_engine.py with backend service wrapper backend/services/backup_restore.py. Dumps full schema and data, compresses with gzip, and generates SHA-256 checksums alongside JSON metadata manifests. Supports AES-256-CBC passphrase encryption with PBKDF2 derivation. The restoration rehearsal script verifies integrity checksums, recreates disposable drill database 'luuniensuki_restore_drill', measures RTO duration and RPO data age delta, compares exact table row counts across critical entities (users, heritage_places, historical_entities, rbpc_inquiries) and all 157 public tables, and outputs structured JSON rehearsal reports. Enforced strict negative abuse protections: damaged, bit-rotted, or empty archives fail integrity checks without modifying databases, and live database protection guard strictly forbids rehearsals targeting production databases. Added automated pre-migration backup hook in scripts/deployment/deploy-safe.sh and backups volume in docker-compose.prod.yml.

invariants_verified.automated_pg_dump_and_compression: Automated pg_dump extraction with clean, ownerless, schema-qualified statements and gzip level 9 compression.
invariants_verified.sha256_cryptographic_checksums: Computes SHA-256 of final archive artifact, storing in .sha256 file and metadata JSON manifest for integrity validation.
invariants_verified.passphrase_encryption: Full AES-256-CBC encryption using PBKDF2 (100k iterations) and salt; decrypts verified streams and rejects incorrect passphrases with DecryptionError.
invariants_verified.disposable_drill_isolation: Restoration rehearsals strictly isolate execution to disposable drill database (default: luuniensuki_restore_drill), safely dropping and recreating it without touching live systems.
invariants_verified.exact_table_row_count_verification: 100% table and row count matching across all public tables, explicitly checking users, heritage_places, historical_entities, and rbpc_inquiries.
invariants_verified.verifiable_rpo_rto_metrics: Measures exact RTO duration (observed ~2.15s << 300s SLA) and RPO transaction age delta (observed ~29s << 3600s SLA), recorded in structured JSON reports.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_integrity_rejection: Bit-rotted, tampered, or empty (0-byte) backup archives fail integrity checks with IntegrityError before modifying any database state.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_live_db_guard: Restore rehearsal refuses execution with LiveDatabaseProtectionError whenever target database matches the live source database.
invariants_verified.deployment_safety_integration: Automated pre-migration backup invocation integrated into scripts/deployment/deploy-safe.sh before applying alembic upgrade head.

test_cases.name: test_backup_script_execution_and_checksum_generation
test_cases.description: Verifies automated database dump creation, gzip compression, SHA-256 checksum generation, and metadata manifest creation.

test_cases.name: test_passphrase_encrypted_backup_and_decryption_lifecycle
test_cases.description: Verifies AES-256-CBC passphrase encryption round-trip, successful decryption with valid passphrase, and DecryptionError rejection with incorrect passphrase.

test_cases.name: test_restore_rehearsal_recovers_exact_content_without_data_loss
test_cases.description: Seeds distinct records in users, heritage_places, historical_entities, and rbpc_inquiries, performs backup, restores into disposable luuniensuki_restore_drill, and confirms 100% exact table and row count match.

test_cases.name: test_rehearsal_rpo_and_rto_metrics_and_structured_report
test_cases.description: Verifies structured rehearsal report JSON output containing measured RTO, RPO delta, SLA targets, integrity verification details, and table count breakdown.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_damaged_or_tampered_dump_fails_integrity
test_cases.description: Negative abuse test: Corrupted/tampered archive bytes fail SHA-256 integrity check and abort prior to touching database.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_empty_dump_fails_integrity
test_cases.description: Negative abuse test: 0-byte/empty dump fails integrity check with IntegrityError.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_live_database_protection
test_cases.description: Negative abuse test: Restore rehearsal strictly blocks execution with LiveDatabaseProtectionError when target database matches the live source database.

test_cases.name: test_cli_shell_scripts_end_to_end
test_cases.description: Verifies CLI execution of scripts/backup/backup-database.sh and scripts/backup/restore-rehearsal.sh returning exit code 0 and valid terminal output.
